title: Unlock the Surprise
summary: Watch Unlock the Surprise and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_markdown:
Something new has arrived at LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch.


Gashapon, the popular Japanese collectibles concept, is now open!


This unique retailer brings an experience built around surprise, discovery, and fan-favorite brands. From Super Mario and Snoopy to Minecraft and more, shoppers can hunt for collectible treasures inspired by some of the world's most recognizable characters and franchises.


Experiential concepts like Gashapon create excitement, encourage repeat visits, and add to the dynamic mix of retailers and restaurants at LaCenterra. We're excited to welcome this globally recognized brand and introduce shoppers to one of Japan's most beloved retail experiences.
